title: Six-mode Home, mobile parity và onboarding completion
scope_items: Target 1 (All six mode priorities): Full preservation of all 6 canonical operator modes (Solo Creator with 7 cards, Seller with 5 cards, Affiliate Operator with 5 cards, Live Operator with 5 cards, Agency/MCN with 5 cards, Brand Collaboration with 5 cards). Each card has a distinct priority rank, WhyThisMatters explanation, and a non-empty actionable PrimaryCtaRoute with zero dead ends per RULE-M01-001.

Target 2 (First-value and full-loop completion distinct): The standard 5-step loop (connect_data, select_offer, create_content, publish, track_outcome) cleanly separates first-value achievement (Step 1 complete -> is_first_value_complete=true) from full closed-loop completion (all 5 steps complete -> is_closed_loop_complete=true). Both states are explicitly distinguished in protobuf contracts, Go service projections, Web UI badges, and Flutter mobile views.

Target 3 (Every shared UI state and route mapped): Shared UI states across Web and Mobile cover all 5 canonical state types (Normal, Loading, Empty, Error, Repair). Why This Number diagnostics drawers/sheets transparently display data source badges (Official/Imported/Inferred/Demo), confidence levels, missing data caveats, and actionable next steps. Role-based security checks redact private financial cards and repair gaps for Viewers.
verified_sub_slices: Target 1 Verified: TestP801AcceptanceTarget1_AllSixModePriorities in apps/api/internal/home passes with go test -race; verifies 7 Creator cards, 5 Seller cards, 5 Affiliate Operator cards, 5 Live Operator cards, 5 Agency/MCN cards, and 5 Brand Collaboration cards with 100% route validity and module references.

Target 2 Verified: TestP801AcceptanceTarget2_FirstValueAndFullLoopCompletionDistinct in apps/api/internal/home passes with go test -race; verifies Step 1 sets is_first_value_complete=true without completing closed-loop, and only 5/5 steps sets is_closed_loop_complete=true.

Target 3 Verified: TestP801AcceptanceTarget3_SharedUIStatesAndRouteMappings in apps/api/internal/home passes with go test -race; verifies all 5 UI state types, 19 shared route mappings, and viewer role financial/repair redaction.

Web Vitest & Svelte Check: apps/web/src/lib/home/decision_engine.test.ts passes all 12 tests in apps/web; svelte-check reports 0 errors and 0 warnings; vite build succeeds cleanly; SSR smoke checks pass across web and admin surfaces.
Mobile Flutter Suite: apps/mobile/test/home_acceptance_test.dart passes all 12 acceptance tests; full suite of 311 tests passes in apps/mobile; flutter analyze passes with 0 issues.
Protobuf Verification: tooling/proto-gen.sh verify passes across Go, TS, and Dart targets with zero drift.
CI Quality Gates: check_docs.py, check_go.sh, check_flutter.sh, and check_node.sh all pass cleanly.

external_gates.description: Six-mode decision engine and onboarding paths operate deterministically with imported datasets and manual routes. Live third-party OAuth connector activation requires production provider credentials.

remaining_scope: P8-02: Full billing, reporting, retention và cost economics
